title: Zero k-density off a carrier at all scales Rr (Upper Density Theorem, Simon Ch. 1, 3.6)
statement: Let P, k ∈ ℕ, Hᵏ := μHE[k] on ℝ^P = Eucl P, U ⊆ ℝ^P open, S ⊆ ℝ^P Hᵏ-null-measurable, and g : ℝ^P → [0, ∞] (not necessarily measurable) with ∫⁻_{S∩K} g dHᵏ < ∞ for every compact K ⊆ U. Then for Hᵏ-almost every x with x ∈ U and x ∉ S, and for every R > 0, r^{−k}·∫⁻_{S ∩ B̄_{Rr}(x)} g dHᵏ → 0 as r ↓ 0 (r^{−k} is written ENNReal.ofReal((r^k)⁻¹), B̄_ρ(x) = closedBall x ρ).
lean_statement: ∀ (P k : ℕ) (U S : Set (Eucl P)) (g : Eucl P → ℝ≥0∞), IsOpen U → NullMeasurableSet S (μHE[k] : Measure (Eucl P)) → (∀ K : Set (Eucl P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → ∫⁻ y in S ∩ K, g y ∂(μHE[k] : Measure (Eucl P)) < ∞) → ∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[k] : Measure (Eucl P)), x ∈ U → x ∉ S → ∀ R : ℝ, 0 < R → Tendsto (fun r : ℝ => ENNReal.ofReal ((r ^ k)⁻¹) * ∫⁻ y in S ∩ closedBall x (R * r), g y ∂(μHE[k] : Measure (Eucl P))) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 0)
